# Roleplay Rule 5 - Be Creative
This servers goal is to give antagonists freedom while also being fun for crew players.
To do this we give antagonists extra leeway than most servers, however there are still limits.
If youre going to go beyond your objectives as an antagonist be creative! Do something HUGE, dont just mow down medbay with guns every round.
## Examples
### [bold] Permitted [/bold]
- Doing massive and destructive gimmicks as an antagonist. - Doing massive gimmicks as crew. - Killing huge amounts of players as an antagnoist.
### [bold] Not Permitted [/bold]
- Doing the same gimmick every single round. - Doing the same antagnoist gimmick every round. - Basically just dont kill everyone in the same way over and over until everyone hates it.
